tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description:
Search live job listings with genuinely better working hours.

Every listing carries an explicit schedule_type, so you never have to infer one:
  - "4_day_week": 36 hours or less, 100% salary. The ONLY type that is reduced hours at full pay.
  - "4_day_week_pro_rata": four days at pro-rata (reduced)
